neighbours.label: ' to' in 'use it to …': the purpose infinitive saying what an agent uses an acquired thing for
fire: Bacteria grab this enzyme and use it to break down sugar.
Farmers collect rainwater and use it to irrigate crops.
Hackers steal passwords and use them to access accounts.
Some birds pick up stones and use them to crack shells.
The parasite hijacks the cell and uses it to make copies.
Engineers capture waste heat and use it to warm homes.
Sharks sense electric fields and use them to find prey.
The company buys old tires and uses them to pave roads.
quiet: Bacteria grab this enzyme and break down sugar quickly.
Farmers collect rainwater in large barrels.
Hackers steal passwords from careless users.
Some birds pick up stones and drop them.
The parasite hijacks the cell and makes copies.
Engineers capture waste heat from the factory.
Sharks sense electric fields in the water.
The company buys old tires from garages.

notes: card top tokens are function words (' in', ' to', ' was'); probes mostly near zero except 'use it to' 0.24
